$comment: What the string scanner (scripts/i18n/lib/scan.cjs, docs/design/output-and-languages.md section 16.1) may find without it being UI text, each with its reason. 'files' are left out whole, 'texts' are patterns over a finding's text (optionally only for some kinds), 'sites' are one file's finding by kind and exact text. Font stacks, ids, ffmpeg arguments, CSS values, test ids and log lines are not scanned at all (they reach no sink); AI prompts in src/main/ai/* go to a service, not to a sink. Add an entry only with its reason; a UI text never belongs here.

files.reason: The development-only review overlay (section 15.4): it shows message keys and states, and never runs in a packaged build.
The MP4 index reader's failures name boxes of a damaged file (moov, avcC, stsc): the export and the timeline catch and log them and fall back to seeking the video element; never shown.
The media range reader's failures (an HTTP status): caught and logged with the MP4 index reader's, never shown.

texts.reason: IPC sender checks: thrown only to a page that is not Flown's own, never shown to a user.
IPC argument checks: thrown only for a malformed call, which Flown's own pages never make; never shown to a user.

sites.reason: The message runtime's own programming errors (a key that does not exist, text made before the messages are registered): for developers and tests, never shown in a working build.
The message parser's programming errors (a message without a value it needs): for developers and the catalogue checks, never shown in a working build.

sites.text: exportArgs builds video and audio exports; GIFs use gifCaptureArgs/gifEncodeArgs
sites.reason: A programming error (a GIF job given to the video builder): for developers and tests, never shown in a working build.
A cancelled request's internal reason: the callers check the signal and say "cancelled" in their own words; never shown.
A closed decoder's internal reason: the frame source is being torn down and nothing shows it.
The camera segmentation worker's failures: the export and preview log them and draw the camera without background blur; never shown.
The GIF format's name drawn inside its icon: a format name, never translated (section 9.7).
The address field's placeholder: the start of a web address, the same in every language.
The preload's size check on a screenshot the app's own page never sends too large (GUIDE_SAVE_LIMITS); the preload has no catalogue and main gives the same refusal through errors.guideIpc.
A kit font that could not be fetched: the internal reason only moves the row to its "could not be read" state, which shows a message of its own.
